name: pulse-docs-research
description: Researches current documentation for Laravel React component work. Use when implementation depends on Inertia React, Wayfinder, React 19, Motion React, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS 4, Jest, React Testing Library, Vite, or other library APIs that may change.
purpose: Provide current, version-aware documentation context for component implementation and review.
single_responsibility: Provide current, version-aware documentation context for the task using Boost, local code, Context7, and web search as a last-resort fallback.
triggers: About to make code changes in this project
Framework, library, or API detail is uncertain
Task touches Inertia, Wayfinder, React, Motion, Radix, Tailwind, Jest, React Testing Library, Vite, or lazy loading
Hydration, SSR, gestures, forms, or testing APIs are involved
completion_criteria: Laravel Boost search-docs is run before code changes
Laravel ecosystem questions use Boost; non-Laravel frontend questions use Context7
Web search is used only as a documented fallback to primary sources
Findings are scoped to the current decision and not over-quoted
Source and version context are recorded
validation_criteria: Source and version context are clear
failure_handling: If authoritative documentation cannot be found in Boost, local code, Context7, or official sources, stop and report the gap instead of inventing API behaviour.
Report which source answered the question and any unresolved version caveats.
escalation_path: Return findings to the owning skill that raised the question.
Flag conflicts between local conventions and current docs to the owning skill.
Escalate to the user when documentation conflicts with required scope or dependencies.
responsibilities: Use Laravel Boost `search-docs` before code changes.
Use local project code and installed supporting skills to understand existing conventions.
Use web search only when local code, installed skills, Boost, and Context7 cannot answer the question.
Capture only documentation relevant to the current task.
Distinguish source facts from local inference.
